svg.title: Structure Score of nine models and three baselines without a language model on Recap, Thread and Design
svg.text: Structure Score (0 to 100) of nine models and three baselines
Each bar is a model's average over the five harnesses; the line runs from its lowest to its highest harness.
Scores from the paper's Tables 3, 11 and 12. Each system ran once on each of the 150 tasks.
